<function=python>
<parameter=code>

# summarize current pieces by hash
nodes = current_frame.segmentation['nodes']
by_hash = {}
for n in nodes:
    h = n['hash']
    by_hash.setdefault(h, []).append(n)
# print each hash with id and boundary min/max
for h, lst in by_hash.items():
    # assume single node per hash
    n = lst[0]
    b = n['boundary']
    rows = [p[0] for p in b]
    cols = [p[1] for p in b]
    print(h[:8], n['color'], n['pixels'], 'r', min(rows), max(rows), 'c', min(cols), max(cols))
# also print adjacency for pieces
adj = current_frame.segmentation['adjacency_list']
# map node id to hash
id_to_hash = {n['id']: n['hash'] for n in nodes}
print('adj hashes:')
for i,j in adj:
    hi = id_to_hash.get(i)
    hj = id_to_hash.get(j)
    print(i,hi,'-',j,hj)
</parameter>
</function>
</tool_call>
